items.statement: The S14 DEVELOPMENT budget failed as computed (19 of 51 gated rows fail; all-cases p90 stress field 5.24%, peak 5.34%, displacement 0.58% against 5%, 5% and 2%); the decision owner accepted it as passing in a signed waiver (ADR 0030), which opened HOLDOUT.

The S14 HOLDOUT budget failed (22 of 51 gated rows fail; all-cases p90 stress field 6.01%, peak 6.40%, displacement 0.53% against 5%, 5% and 2%), so the claim level is at most DEVELOPMENT_VERIFIED: the predictions are not verified to the S14 tolerances on unseen cases.
The HOLDOUT budget was checked on a finite sample of 64 cases; it is evidence, not a uniform error bound.
The confidence bound is the DEVELOPMENT-calibrated 90% quantile of the pointwise in-plane stress error given the equilibrium-residual indicator; its HOLDOUT coverage was 87.7%.
Predictions are verified against FEM solutions of the same plane-stress model, not against physical measurements.
Only requests inside the sealed envelope notched-v1-strain-controlled-10-20-v1 are served; everything else is refused with a reason code.

One compressible Neo-Hookean material (E = 760 MPa, nu = 0.23) in 2D finite-strain plane stress with 1 mm reference thickness, under displacement-controlled nominal axial strain from 10% to 20%, on the quarter model of a 50 mm plate with two symmetry planes.
The served stress is constitutive: P_served is the plane-stress Neo-Hookean first Piola stress of the predicted deformation (ADR 0018). There is no independent stress head.
The peak QoI is scored against an L2-recovered P2 FEM stress at the notch-profile vertices; it is mesh- and recovery-dependent and not a certified physical maximum.
The sealed design's empirical fill distance (0.124) exceeds the proposal's 0.10 target; every stratum, boundary, interaction and difficult-region quota was met.

paragraph: PI-GINOT performs numerical verification against finite element method (FEM) solutions. That is not experimental validation, and it does not show that predictions agree with measurements from physical specimens. Verification for a bundle establishes nothing about geometries outside that bundle's declared input envelope. Inputs outside the envelope must not be treated as covered by the bundle's results. Finite verification sampling is evidence about the evaluated cases, not a mathematical proof of a uniform error bound over every admissible input.
